The '''Jedi Hunters''' were a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] who hunted down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|149|Jedi Hunters}}</ref>
